shop.theme_sections.faq:
How long does an 8 oz candle burn? About 45 to 50 hours if you trim the wick each time.
Do you sell wholesale? Yes. Email hello@juniperandlane.example for the line sheet.
shop.theme_sections.story:
I started pouring candles in my kitchen in 2022 because I missed the smell of the Blue Ridge in winter.
Every scent is named for a trail I hike.
shop.theme_sections.signup: New scents first, one email a month
